claims.text: The Miami Heat partnered with Rockstar Games for a collaboration related to the upcoming release of GTA 6.
The Miami Heat unveiled a special edition Vice City-themed basketball court.
The collaboration between the Miami Heat and Rockstar Games is valued at $975,000.
The Miami Heat placed a Vice City logo on top of the Kaseya Center on November 18.
